## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +3.11%) ↑ rising and TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.06% | 1M: -1.79%) → flat show stocks stronger but bond resilience; sector breadth mixed (6/11) reinforces a neutral stance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit steady: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.23%) → flat. Fear easing: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -8.09%) ↓ falling. Stocks vs bonds mixed: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +3.11%) vs TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.06% | 1M: -1.79%) → flat.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: HYG/LQD mixed with HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.23%) → flat and LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -0.79%) → flat; balance between credit and duration keeps conditions neutral.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +2.17%) ↑ rising. Financials participating: Financials sector ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +6.89%) ↑ rising. Defensives lag: XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.72% | 1M: -4.22%) ↓ falling; Style: Growth/Momentum showing leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +3.11%) ↑ rising. EM mixed: EEM RECOVERY (1W: +2.25% | 1M: -1.83%) ↑ rising. China uneven: FXI CORRECTION (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +7.51%) ↓ falling.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Cautious speculation: ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +3.88% | 1M: -5.53%) ↑ rising but 1M negative, IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -0.57% | 1M: +3.58%) → flat; VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -8.09%) ↓ falling reduces immediate fear.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious and industrial metals strong: PALL ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +12.32%) ↑ rising and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.61% | 1M: +9.95%) ↑ rising. Gold bullish: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.32% | 1M: +4.06%) ↑ rising.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Mixed energy: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +4.60%) ↓ falling and BNO CORRECTION (1W: -4.61% | 1M: +8.72%) ↓ falling, while UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -16.98%) ↓ falling highlights natural gas weakness.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +3.11%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +2.17%) both timeframes positive. Divergences: multiple RECOVERY/ CORRECTION signals (SOXX RECOVERY, XBI RECOVERY, ARKK RECOVERY, FXI CORRECTION) indicate sector-level momentum mismatches to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to growth/tech and cyclicals showing strength given XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +2.17%) and Financials ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +6.89%); reduce exposure to weak natural gas and utilities such as UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -16.98%) and XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.72% | 1M: -4.22%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +2.17%)) and Materials/Metals (XME ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +8.25%)). BEARISH: Utilities (XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.72% | 1M: -4.22%)) and Energy pullbacks (XLE CORRECTION (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +4.60%)).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals (CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.61% | 1M: +9.95%)) and palladium/palladium proxies (PALL ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +12.32%)). BEARISH: Natural gas (UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -16.98%)) and oil near-term pullbacks (BNO CORRECTION (1W: -4.61% | 1M: +8.72%)).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD convergence (monitor HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.23%) vs LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -0.79%)); XLK/ XLF relative ratio ~ monitor pivot level as tech vs financials leadership signal; SPY 1M performance inflection (keep SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +3.11%) in focus).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +3.11%) and TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.06% | 1M: -1.79%) producing offsetting signals. Tech and cyclical sectors (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +2.17%); Financials ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +6.89%)) showing relative strength while energy and utilities display short-term weakness to watch.
